resources.string: You chose a new icon and logo. They take effect after ECHO TV restarts.
This address is for the ECHO TV app on your other device. Open Local sync there and pick this device from the list.
This device could not be reached. On it, open ECHO TV → Settings → Data → Local sync and turn Sync mode on. Both devices must be on the same Wi-Fi.
Colour of the ECHO TV icon and logo
Stage draws ECHO TV’s own soft colours. Picture shows a picture of yours behind every screen. Plain is a flat dark fill.
The ECHO TV logo in the menu, About and setup shows its play triangle in your accent colour. The icon on the home screen keeps its own colours.
Looks on GitHub for a newer ECHO TV now and offers to install it. Your playlists, favourites and settings stay as they are.
What ECHO TV shows when it starts: Home, the channel you watched last, your favourites, or a channel you pick.
